Proven experience. Global impact.

Built for critical applications.

From creeks and rivers to lakes, ponds, stormwater systems and coastlines, Er-Con combines disciplined engineering, proprietary systems and decades of field experience to protect infrastructure, property and natural resources.

Our work spans exposed pipeline remediation, bank stabilization, channel restoration, bridge protection and other complex erosion-control challenges.

With over 3,000 completed projects around the world, Er-Con brings proven performance to demanding environments.

River Stabilization

Address severe bank retreat threatening pipeline easements, rail subgrades, highway approaches, and high-value waterfront property.

Pipeline Free Spans

Correcting exposure and restoring reliable support.

Pipeline Exposures

Addressing the conditions that cause loss of cover, stabilizing the site and protecting the pipeline from continued erosion.

Critical Infrastructure

Protecting crossings, bridges and surrounding property.

Erosion Control Systems

Site-specific systems engineered and installed to manage flow, stabilize vulnerable ground and protect critical assets.

How we deliver

Dedicated expertise at every stage.

Our in-house teams connect technical evaluation, engineering, permitting and field execution, giving clients a single accountable partner from initial site assessment through installation.

Surveys

Document the field condition, surrounding constraints and forces acting on the site. Give engineering the information needed to distinguish the visible symptom from the underlying problem.

Scoping

Define the problem, the assets at risk and the boundaries of the work. Evaluate alternatives and establish a clear, defensible path forward.

Drawings

Translate field conditions into practical, site-specific engineering and construction documents. Give crews clear direction while accounting for constructability, sequencing and long-term performance.

Environmental Permitting

Navigate environmental review, applications, agency coordination and compliance requirements. Identify permitting constraints early so they do not become costly surprises in the field.

Installations

Carry the engineered solution through field execution with attention to safety, quality and changing site conditions. Resolve field challenges without losing the intent of the design.

Long-Term Protection

A site-specific solution that addresses the forces behind the problem, stabilizes the site and protects critical assets for years to come.

Engineering + field execution

Solutions designed around the problem, not the other way around.

Er-Con engineers each solution around the forces acting on the site, the assets at risk and the realities of construction. That discipline creates a clear path from field investigation and permitting through installation.

  • Site-specific approach
  • Constructability built into the solution
  • Accountability from site assessment through installation

How we work

Expertise that travels. Local knowledge that matters.

Er-Con brings dedicated teams, proven systems and project leadership to every site. Wherever practical, we leverage local experience through contractors, equipment providers and material suppliers, supporting the surrounding community while maintaining ownership of the work from start to finish.

Our crews minimize disruption to the customer, surrounding property and environment. They limit the project footprint, restore disturbed areas and leave the site better than they found it. Customers regularly recognize Er-Con for the care our teams bring to the work.
